note: The stability margin no longer depends on how a part is clocked. The app measured the centre of pressure in one plane, at roll angle zero, so a rocket with fewer than three fins - or a single camera shroud - reported a margin that changed when you rotated that part: a one-finned test rocket read -5.346 cal with the fin at 0 degrees and +1.696 cal at 90. It now reports the most-forward CP over a full roll sweep, which is what desktop OpenRocket shows. Three or more fins are unaffected, measured identical to 15 significant figures. A camera shroud mounted straight up or down now moves the CP instead of reporting a 0.00 cal shift, and the single-plane figure is still there as "CP in this plane" in All stats.
